## Analysis of the "Create Event" Form UI Let me first examine the current codebase to understand the existing form/dialog implementation before providing optimization recommendations.Let me explore the current form/dialog implementation in the repository to understand the codebase before providing optimization recommendations.Now let me get more details about the auto-layout logic and the form rendering within the modal:Now let me look at the full `ModalForm.tsx` rendering to understand the complete picture, and also the `FormSection` and the DialogContent styling:Now let me also check the ROADMAP for any existing mobile UX items related to this form dialog and what open issues may be relevant:Now let me also look at the DialogContent base component to understand the current mobile styles:Now I have a thorough understanding of the codebase. Let me provide a comprehensive UX optimization analysis of this "Create Event" modal form on mobile. --- ## 📱 "Create Event" ModalForm Mobile UX Optimization Analysis Based on the screenshot from `demo.objectui.org` and deep analysis of the codebase, I've identified **8 optimization areas** across 3 layers: **DialogContent (primitives)**, **ModalForm (plugin)**, and **Form Renderer (components)**. --- ### 🔍 Issue Summary | # | Issue | Severity | Layer | |---|-------|----------|-------| | 1 | Modal not full-screen on mobile (wasted viewport space) | 🔴 High | `dialog.tsx` + `ModalForm.tsx` | | 2 | No sticky footer for action buttons (Cancel/Save Record) | 🔴 High | `ModalForm.tsx` | | 3 | Fields don't collapse to 1-column on narrow screens | 🟡 Medium | `ModalForm.tsx` auto-layout | | 4 | Close button (×) touch target too small | 🟡 Medium | `dialog.tsx` | | 5 | No visual separation between field groups | 🟢 Low | `ModalForm.tsx` render | | 6 | Date/DateTime fields lack native mobile pickers | 🟡 Medium | Field renderers | | 7 | Participants (Lookup) search input not mobile-optimized | 🟡 Medium | Lookup field | | 8 | Loading skeleton missing for better perceived performance | 🟢 Low | `ModalForm.tsx` | --- ### 1. 🔴 Modal Should Be Full-Screen on Mobile **Current state:** The `DialogContent` uses a centered `fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] translate` positioning with `max-w-lg`, which wastes significant viewport space on small screens. The ROADMAP already marks this as `[x] Full-screen modal on mobile`, but the current `dialog.tsx` doesn't implement it: ```tsx name=packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/370f34e5a47e417474093af7b4adec6cc01cbd27/packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx#L46-L51 ``` **Recommendation:** Update `DialogContent` to be full-screen on mobile and centered on desktop: ```tsx name=dialog.tsx (proposed change) // Replace the fixed center positioning with mobile-first full-screen "fixed inset-0 z-50 grid w-full bg-background p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-lg duration-200 " + "sm:inset-auto sm:left-[50%] sm:top-[50%] sm:translate-x-[-50%] sm:translate-y-[-50%] " + "sm:max-w-lg sm:rounded-lg sm:border " + "h-[100dvh] sm:h-auto sm:max-h-[90vh] " + "overflow-y-auto" ``` And in `ModalForm.tsx`, use `100dvh` on mobile: ```tsx name=ModalForm.tsx (proposed change for line 383) ``` --- ### 2. 🔴 Sticky Footer for Action Buttons **Current state:** The "Cancel" and "Save Record" buttons scroll with the form content, making them invisible until the user scrolls to the very bottom. On mobile, this is a critical UX failure — users need persistent access to primary actions. **Current ModalForm structure:** ```tsx name=packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/370f34e5a47e417474093af7b4adec6cc01cbd27/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx#L381-L396 return ( {(schema.title || schema.description) && ( ... )}
{renderContent()} {/* Submit/Cancel buttons are INSIDE the scrollable area */}
); ``` **Recommendation:** Restructure to a flex layout with sticky header + scrollable body + sticky footer: ```tsx name=ModalForm.tsx (proposed restructure) {/* Sticky Header */} {(schema.title || schema.description) && ( {schema.title && {schema.title}} {schema.description && {schema.description}} )} {/* Scrollable Body */}
{renderContent()} {/* Form fields only, no buttons */}
{/* Sticky Footer */}
{schema.showCancel !== false && ( )} {schema.showSubmit !== false && schema.mode !== 'view' && ( )}
``` --- ### 3. 🟡 Auto-Layout Should Force 1 Column on Mobile The auto-layout system correctly infers multi-column for many fields, but the screenshot shows that "Subject + Start" and "End + Location" are rendered side-by-side even on narrow mobile. The grid responsive classes in the form renderer do handle this: ```tsx name=packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/370f34e5a47e417474093af7b4adec6cc01cbd27/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx#L164-L172 const gridColsClass = columns === 1 ? '' : columns === 2 ? 'sm:grid-cols-2' : columns === 3 ? 'sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3' : 'sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4'; ``` This means with `columns=2`, the breakpoint is `sm:grid-cols-2` (640px). The screenshot device appears to be ~390px wide, so the fields **should** be stacking to 1 column. However, from the screenshot, Subject and Start appear side-by-side. This suggests: - **Either** the Event object schema has explicit `columns: 2` being applied differently - **Or** the form is rendering in a 2-column grid and the `sm:` breakpoint isn't taking effect due to viewport width reporting **Recommendation:** Verify the Event form isn't bypassing auto-layout with a hardcoded `columns` value. If the screenshot is accurate, consider changing `sm:grid-cols-2` to `md:grid-cols-2` for better mobile stacking: ```tsx name=form.tsx (proposed) // Change breakpoint from sm (640px) to md (768px) for 2-column layouts columns === 2 ? 'md:grid-cols-2' : ``` --- ### 4. 🟡 Close Button Touch Target Too Small ```tsx name=packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/370f34e5a47e417474093af7b4adec6cc01cbd27/packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx#L55-L58 Close ``` The `h-4 w-4` (16×16px) icon with no explicit padding makes the touch target far below the WCAG 2.5.5 minimum of 44×44px. **Recommendation:** ```tsx name=dialog.tsx (proposed close button) Close ``` --- ### 5. 🟡 Date Fields ("Start", "End") Should Use Native Mobile Pickers From the screenshot, "Start" and "End" appear as plain text inputs. On mobile, these should leverage `` to trigger the native OS date/time picker, which provides a far better UX than custom date pickers. The field renderer already handles `inputType`: ```tsx name=packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/370f34e5a47e417474093af7b4adec6cc01cbd27/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx#L467-L468 case 'input': return ; ``` **Recommendation:** Ensure `mapFieldTypeToFormType` maps `datetime` fields to `inputType: 'datetime-local'` on mobile, and consider a responsive approach where desktop gets the custom DatePicker and mobile gets the native input. --- ### 6. 🟢 Improve Visual Hierarchy Between Field Groups Looking at the screenshot, all 7 fields (Subject, Start, End, Location, Description, Participants, Type) flow as a flat list with no visual grouping. For an Event form, logical grouping would improve scanability: **Recommendation:** Use `sections` in the ModalForm schema: ```tsx name=Event form schema (proposed) sections: [ { label: 'Event Details', columns: 2, fields: ['subject', 'start', 'end', 'location'], }, { label: 'Description', columns: 1, fields: ['description'], }, { label: 'Participants & Type', columns: 2, fields: ['participants', 'type'], }, ] ``` --- ### 7. 🟢 Loading State Could Use Skeleton Instead of Spinner ```tsx name=packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/370f34e5a47e417474093af7b4adec6cc01cbd27/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx#L332-L339 if (loading) { return (

Loading form...

); } ``` **Recommendation:** Replace the spinner with field-shaped skeletons (Shadcn `Skeleton`) that match the expected form layout, providing better perceived performance and less layout shift. --- ### 📊 Impact Matrix | Optimization | UX Impact | Effort | Priority | |---|---|---|---| | Full-screen modal on mobile | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | P0 | | Sticky action button footer | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | P0 | | 1-column force on mobile | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Low | P1 | | Close button touch target | ⭐⭐⭐ | Low | P1 | | Native date pickers on mobile | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Medium | P1 | | Field group sections | ⭐⭐ | Low | P2 | | Skeleton loading state | ⭐⭐ | Low | P2 | ### 🏗️ Files to Change (in priority order) 1. **`packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx`** — Mobile full-screen layout + touch-target close button 2. **`packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx`** — Flex layout restructure (sticky header/footer), skeleton loading 3. **`packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`** — Adjust grid breakpoint from `sm:` to `md:` for 2-col 4. **`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`** — Responsive date/datetime field type mapping 5. **`apps/console/src/App.tsx`** — Update Event form schema to use sections Would you like me to create a PR implementing any of these optimizations, or create issues to track them individually?
